mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies near the Verona Public Library with temperatures at 55 degrees and a New Moon overhead.
City updates include important notices regarding the November general election, along with ongoing engineering reports and a report from the police department regarding a residential burglary.
There is plenty to do in town, with the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival and live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard both taking place today, followed by yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow.
On September 10, Verona police responded to a burglary call on Hunter's Cove Way where they apprehended a suspect after a reported gunshot, though no injuries were caused by the firearm.
Today's flavor of the day is Really Reese's. Culver's is currently closed, but they open today at 10:00 AM.
